Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of health to study the potential to divert ambulances to urgent care facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying the potential to divert ambulances tourgent care; adding a new section to chapter 18.73 RCW; and providingan expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.73 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall complete a study of the potential todivert ambulances to urgent care facilities when appropriate. Thedepartment may convene a stakeholder group including the ambulanceservice providers, emergency department providers, urgent carefacilities, and insurance carriers. The study must be provided to thehealth committees of the legislature by October 1, 2013, and mustinclude recommendations on any statutory changes needed. (2) This section expires August 1, 2014.
